# BenchDB

> BenchDB is a self-hosted server for benchmark results. Benchmark jobs write
> JSON results, and the `benchdb` CLI uploads them to a Go API backed by
> PostgreSQL. BenchDB keeps each benchmark's history per machine and serves it
> through a dashboard, the CLI, and an OpenAPI document.

The Guide follows one result from benchmark run to CI report. The Docs pages
below are task references. Every rendered page at `/docs/<page>/` is also
served as raw Markdown at `/docs/<page>.md`.

## Start here

- [Documentation overview](https://benchdb.io/docs.md): Which page answers which task, and the commands for each
- [Quickstart](https://benchdb.io/docs/quickstart.md): Build the CLI, submit one result, and find it in the dashboard
- [Concepts](https://benchdb.io/docs/concepts.md): Results, runs, benchmarks, series, history fingerprints, and statuses
- [Agent and automation guide](https://benchdb.io/docs/agents.md): The order to integrate in, the rules that must hold, and where each fact is defined

## Publish and investigate

- [Submitting results](https://benchdb.io/docs/submitting-results.md): Result JSON fields, file layout, retries, and attachments
- [CI reporting](https://benchdb.io/docs/ci-reporting.md): Run selection, baseline modes, statuses, exit codes, and GitHub publishing
- [Browsing and comparing](https://benchdb.io/docs/browsing-and-comparing.md): Dashboard pages, URL parameters, trends, exports, and comparisons
- [Regression analysis](https://benchdb.io/docs/regression-analysis.md): How BenchDB decides a benchmark regressed, for CI reports and for the Benchmarks page
- [Dashboard screenshots](https://benchdb.io/docs/dashboard-screenshots.md): Captioned screenshots of each dashboard page

## Automate and operate

- [Alerting](https://benchdb.io/docs/alerting.md): Alert rules, scheduled evaluation, and delivery
- [API and SDK](https://benchdb.io/docs/api-and-sdk.md): The OpenAPI document and the generated Go and TypeScript clients
- [CLI reference](https://benchdb.io/docs/cli-reference.md): Every `benchdb` command, flag, and environment variable
- [Authentication and tokens](https://benchdb.io/docs/auth-and-tokens.md): OIDC sign-in for people and reporter tokens for automation
- [Operations](https://benchdb.io/docs/operations.md): Configuration, containers, migrations, health checks, and deployment
- [Upgrading](https://benchdb.io/docs/upgrading.md): Back up, migrate, roll out, and roll back, plus rebuilding databases from before the schema reset
- [Production clone compatibility](https://benchdb.io/docs/prod-clone-compatibility.md): Checking a release against a read-only copy of production data
- [Storage roadmap](https://benchdb.io/docs/storage-roadmap.md): What the storage layer does today, what is decided, and what is proposed
- [Contributing](https://benchdb.io/docs/contributing.md): Fork pull requests, local development, and the checks CI runs
